review.assessment: This change introduces a `retry` function that attempts the callable up to `attempts` times, silently swallowing any exception inside the loop. It completely omits re-raising the final exception upon exhaustion, instead implicitly returning `None`. As written, it fails to meet the specification for handling complete failure.

findings.actual: Exits cleanly with exit code 0; no exception is propagated
findings.call: python -c "from solution import retry; retry(lambda: (_ for _ in ()).__next__(), 3)"
findings.defect: Exception exhaustion swallows the final error instead of re-raising it
findings.expected: Raises the exception from the final attempt (e.g., StopIteration or ValueError)
